sql.if: AND (B.RGTR_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_mnpw AM WHERE AM.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID AND AM.USER_ID = #{userId} AND AM.USE_YN = 'Y' ))

mapper.select:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT S.SCHDL_SN) FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND S.CO_ID = #{coId} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN DATE(S.BGNG_DT) AND DATE(S.END_DT)) AS todayScheduleCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_info B WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND (B.RGTR_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_mnpw M WHERE M.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' ))) AS myProjectCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT S.SCHDL_SN) FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND S.CO_ID = #{coId} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.BGNG_DT < DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND S.END_DT >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')) AS monthScheduleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_work_item W WHERE W.CO_ID = #{coId} AND W.USER_ID = #{userId} AND W.USE_YN = 'Y' AND W.WORK_YMD <= CURDATE() AND (W.DONE_YMD IS NULL OR W.DONE_YMD >= CURDATE()) AND IFNULL(W.PRGRS_STTS_CD, 'WAIT') <> 'DONE') AS activeDailyPlanCount

SELECT S.SCHDL_SN AS schdlSn, S.SCHDL_NM AS schdlNm, S.SCHDL_SE_CD AS schdlSeCd, IFNULL(C.CD_NM, S.SCHDL_SE_CD) AS schdlSeNm, DATE_FORMAT(S.BGNG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bgngYmd, DATE_FORMAT(S.BGNG_DT, '%H:%i') AS bgngTm, DATE_FORMAT(S.END_DT, '%H:%i') AS endTm, S.ALL_DAY_YN AS allDayYn, S.PLACE_NM AS placeNm, B.BIZ_NM AS bizNm FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID = 'CAL_SCHDL_SE_CD' AND C.CD = S.SCHDL_SE_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID = S.BIZ_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND S.CO_ID = #{coId} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN DATE(S.BGNG_DT) AND DATE(S.END_DT) ORDER BY S.ALL_DAY_YN DESC, S.BGNG_DT LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT B.BIZ_ID) AS projectCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN B.BIZ_STTS_CD = 'PRGRS' THEN B.BIZ_ID END) AS activeProjectCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD <= CURDATE()) AND (M.INPUT_END_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_END_YMD >= CURDATE()) THEN CONCAT(CASE WHEN M.USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND M.USER_ID <> '' THEN CONCAT('USER:',M.USER_ID,':') ELSE 'EXT:' END, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(M.INPUT_MNPW_NM),''),'이름없음')) END) AS inputMnpwCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.SCHDL_END_YMD BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN S.BIZ_SCHDL_SN END) AS dueScheduleCount FROM biz_info B LEFT JOIN biz_mnpw M ON M.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID LEFT JOIN biz_schdl S ON S.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId}

SELECT B.BIZ_ID AS bizId, B.BIZ_NM AS bizNm, B.BIZ_STTS_CD AS bizSttsCd, IFNULL(C.CD_NM, B.BIZ_STTS_CD) AS bizSttsNm, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biz_mnpw PM WHERE PM.BIZ_ID=B.BIZ_ID AND PM.USER_ID=#{userId} AND PM.USE_YN='Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS participatingYn, B.BIZ_BGNG_YMD AS bizBgngYmd, B.BIZ_END_YMD AS bizEndYmd, CASE WHEN B.BIZ_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR B.BIZ_END_YMD IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN B.BIZ_END_YMD <= B.BIZ_BGNG_YMD THEN 100 ELSE LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, ROUND(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), B.BIZ_BGNG_YMD) * 100 / DATEDIFF(B.BIZ_END_YMD, B.BIZ_BGNG_YMD)))) END AS periodProgress, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_mnpw M WHERE M.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD <= CURDATE()) AND (M.INPUT_END_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_END_YMD >= CURDATE())) AS inputMnpwCount FROM biz_info B LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID = 'BIZ_STTS_CD' AND C.CD = B.BIZ_STTS_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId}
ORDER BY participatingYn DESC, FIELD(B.BIZ_STTS_CD, 'PRGRS', 'READY', 'HOLD', 'CMPTN', 'CANCEL'), B.BIZ_END_YMD, B.BIZ_NM LIMIT 8

SELECT S.BIZ_SCHDL_SN AS bizSchdlSn, S.SCHDL_NM AS schdlNm, S.SCHDL_BGNG_YMD AS schdlBgngYmd, S.SCHDL_END_YMD AS schdlEndYmd, B.BIZ_NM AS bizNm, U.USER_NM AS picNm, DATEDIFF(S.SCHDL_END_YMD, CURDATE()) AS remainDay FROM biz_schdl S JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID = S.BIZ_ID LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID = S.PIC_ID WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.SCHDL_END_YMD >= CURDATE()
ORDER BY S.SCHDL_END_YMD, S.BIZ_SCHDL_SN LIMIT 6
mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE dept_ancestor AS ( SELECT D.DEPT_ID, D.UP_DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_SE_CD, 0 AS DEPTH FROM dept_info D WHERE D.CO_ID = #{coId} AND D.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT P.DEPT_ID, P.UP_DEPT_ID, P.DEPT_SE_CD, A.DEPTH + 1 FROM dept_info P JOIN dept_ancestor A ON A.UP_DEPT_ID = P.DEPT_ID WHERE P.CO_ID = #{coId} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEPTH < 10 ), scope_root AS ( SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT A.DEPT_ID FROM dept_ancestor A WHERE A.DEPT_SE_CD = 'HQ' ORDER BY A.DEPTH DESC LIMIT 1), #{deptId} ) AS DEPT_ID ), dept_scope AS ( SELECT D.DEPT_ID FROM dept_info D WHERE D.CO_ID = #{coId} AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (#{allCompanyYn} = 'Y' OR D.DEPT_ID = (SELECT R.DEPT_ID FROM scope_root R)) UNION SELECT C.DEPT_ID FROM dept_info C JOIN dept_scope P ON C.UP_DEPT_ID = P.DEPT_ID WHERE C.CO_ID = #{coId} AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ), scope_user AS ( SELECT U.USER_ID, U.DEPT_ID FROM user_info U WHERE U.CO_ID = #{coId} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (#{allCompanyYn} = 'Y' OR U.DEPT_ID IN (SELECT DEPT_ID FROM dept_scope)) )
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scope_user) AS orgUserCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT H.USER_ID) FROM work_hstry H JOIN scope_user U ON U.USER_ID = H.USER_ID WHERE H.WORK_YMD = CURDATE() AND H.GTWK_DT IS NOT NULL) AS todayAttendCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT R.USER_ID) FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN JOIN scope_user U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID WHERE S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.SCHDL_SE_CD IN ('VAC','BIZTRIP','OUTSIDE','HOME','CLIENT') AND NOW() BETWEEN S.BGNG_DT AND S.END_DT) AS externalUserCount, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(X.TOTAL_RT)), 0) FROM (SELECT M.USER_ID, SUM(M.INPUT_RT) AS TOTAL_RT FROM biz_mnpw M JOIN scope_user U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD <= CURDATE()) AND (M.INPUT_END_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_END_YMD >= CURDATE()) GROUP BY M.USER_ID) X) AS avgInputRate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT M.USER_ID FROM biz_mnpw M JOIN scope_user U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD <= CURDATE()) AND (M.INPUT_END_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_END_YMD >= CURDATE()) GROUP BY M.USER_ID HAVING SUM(M.INPUT_RT) > 100) O) AS overInputUserCount

SELECT D.DEPT_ID AS deptId, D.DEPT_NM AS deptNm, COUNT(DISTINCT U.USER_ID) AS userCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN H.GTWK_DT IS NOT NULL THEN U.USER_ID END) AS attendCount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(IR.TOTAL_RT)), 0) AS avgInputRate FROM dept_info D JOIN dept_scope DS ON DS.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN scope_user U ON U.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN work_hstry H ON H.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND H.WORK_YMD = CURDATE() LEFT JOIN ( SELECT M.USER_ID, SUM(M.INPUT_RT) AS TOTAL_RT FROM biz_mnpw M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD <= CURDATE()) AND (M.INPUT_END_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_END_YMD >= CURDATE()) GROUP BY M.USER_ID ) IR ON IR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID GROUP BY D.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NM, D.SORT_SEQ ORDER BY D.SORT_SEQ, D.DEPT_NM LIMIT 10

SELECT S.SCHDL_NM AS schdlNm, S.SCHDL_SE_CD AS schdlSeCd, IFNULL(C.CD_NM, S.SCHDL_SE_CD) AS schdlSeNm, DATE_FORMAT(S.BGNG_DT, '%H:%i') AS bgngTm, DATE_FORMAT(S.END_DT, '%H:%i') AS endTm, U.USER_NM AS userNm, D.DEPT_NM AS deptNm FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN JOIN scope_user SU ON SU.USER_ID = R.USER_ID JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID = SU.USER_ID LEFT JOIN dept_info D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID = 'CAL_SCHDL_SE_CD' AND C.CD = S.SCHDL_SE_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN DATE(S.BGNG_DT) AND DATE(S.END_DT) ORDER BY S.BGNG_DT, U.USER_NM LIMIT 8

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info U WHERE U.CO_ID = #{coId} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y') AS employeeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_info B WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND B.BIZ_STTS_CD = 'PRGRS') AS activeProjectCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(B.CTRT_AMT), 0) FROM biz_info B WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND B.BIZ_STTS_CD = 'PRGRS') AS activeContractAmount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(C.OCRN_CST), 0) FROM biz_cst C JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID = C.BIZ_ID WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.OCRN_YMD BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND LAST_DAY(CURDATE())) AS monthCostAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_info B WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND B.CTRT_YMD BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND LAST_DAY(CURDATE())) AS monthContractCount

SELECT B.BIZ_ID AS bizId, B.BIZ_NM AS bizNm, B.CTRT_AMT AS ctrtAmt, IFNULL(SUM(C.OCRN_CST), 0) AS costAmt, IFNULL(B.CTRT_AMT, 0) - IFNULL(SUM(C.OCRN_CST), 0) AS currentProfitAmt, B.BIZ_END_YMD AS bizEndYmd FROM biz_info B LEFT JOIN biz_cst C ON C.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND B.BIZ_STTS_CD = 'PRGRS' GROUP BY B.BIZ_ID, B.BIZ_NM, B.CTRT_AMT, B.BIZ_END_YMD ORDER BY B.BIZ_END_YMD, B.BIZ_NM LIMIT 8

SELECT W.WORK_ITEM_SN AS workItemSn, W.WORK_CN AS workCn, W.WORK_YMD AS taskBgngYmd, W.EXPT_END_YMD AS exptEndYmd, W.PRIORITY_NO AS priorityNo, COALESCE(P.PRGRS_STTS_CD, W.PRGRS_STTS_CD, 'WAIT') AS prgrsSttsCd, COALESCE(P.PRGRS_RT, W.PRGRS_RT, 0) AS prgrsRt, B.BIZ_NM AS bizNm, B.BIZ_ABRV_NM AS bizAbrvNm, DATEDIFF(W.EXPT_END_YMD, CURDATE()) AS remainDay FROM daily_work_item W LEFT JOIN daily_work_progress P ON P.WORK_ITEM_SN = W.WORK_ITEM_SN AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' AND P.PRGRS_YMD = ( SELECT MAX(P2.PRGRS_YMD) FROM daily_work_progress P2 WHERE P2.WORK_ITEM_SN = W.WORK_ITEM_SN AND P2.USE_YN = 'Y' AND P2.PRGRS_YMD <= CURDATE() ) LEFT JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID = W.BIZ_ID WHERE W.CO_ID = #{coId} AND W.USER_ID = #{userId} AND W.USE_YN = 'Y' AND W.WORK_YMD <= CURDATE() AND (W.DONE_YMD IS NULL OR W.DONE_YMD >= CURDATE()) AND COALESCE(P.PRGRS_STTS_CD, W.PRGRS_STTS_CD, 'WAIT') <> 'DONE' ORDER BY IFNULL(W.PRIORITY_NO, 3), W.EXPT_END_YMD, W.WORK_ITEM_SN LIMIT 8

SELECT N.NOTICE_SN AS noticeSn, N.NOTICE_SCOPE_CD AS noticeScopeCd, N.NOTICE_TITLE AS noticeTitle, U.USER_NM AS rgtrNm, DATE_FORMAT(N.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS regYmd FROM notice_info N LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID = N.RGTR_ID WHERE N.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (N.NOTICE_SCOPE_CD = 'SYSTEM' OR (N.NOTICE_SCOPE_CD = 'COMPANY' AND N.CO_ID = #{coId})) AND (N.BGNG_DT IS NULL OR N.BGNG_DT <= NOW()) AND (N.END_DT IS NULL OR N.END_DT >= NOW()) ORDER BY CASE WHEN N.NOTICE_SCOPE_CD = 'SYSTEM' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, N.NOTICE_SN DESC LIMIT 6

choose.when: SELECT S.SCHDL_SN AS itemId, S.SCHDL_NM AS title, CONCAT(CASE WHEN S.ALL_DAY_YN='Y' THEN '종일' ELSE CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(S.BGNG_DT,'%H:%i'),' ~ ',DATE_FORMAT(S.END_DT,'%H:%i')) END) AS subTitle, IFNULL(B.BIZ_NM,S.PLACE_NM) AS meta, IFNULL(C.CD_NM,S.SCHDL_SE_CD) AS badge, 'SCHEDULE' AS actionType, DATE_FORMAT(S.BGNG_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') AS actionDate, S.SCHDL_SN AS actionValue FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN=S.SCHDL_SN AND R.USER_ID=#{userId} LEFT JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID=S.BIZ_ID LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID='CAL_SCHDL_SE_CD' AND C.CD=S.SCHDL_SE_CD AND C.USE_YN='Y' WHERE S.CO_ID=#{coId} AND S.USE_YN='Y' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN DATE(S.BGNG_DT) AND DATE(S.END_DT) ORDER BY S.ALL_DAY_YN DESC,S.BGNG_DT,S.SCHDL_SN LIMIT 30

SELECT B.BIZ_ID AS itemId, B.BIZ_NM AS title, CASE WHEN B.RGTR_ID = #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_mnpw M WHERE M.BIZ_ID=B.BIZ_ID AND M.USER_ID=#{userId} AND M.USE_YN='Y') THEN '본인 등록 · 투입인력' WHEN B.RGTR_ID = #{userId} THEN '본인 등록 프로젝트' ELSE '투입인력 등록 프로젝트' END AS subTitle, IFNULL(B.BIZ_ABRV_NM, '내 프로젝트') AS meta, IFNULL(C.CD_NM, B.BIZ_STTS_CD) AS badge, 'BIZ' AS actionType, CONCAT('/biz/bizDetail.do?bizId=', B.BIZ_ID) AS href FROM biz_info B LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID = 'BIZ_STTS_CD' AND C.CD = B.BIZ_STTS_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND (B.RGTR_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_mnpw M WHERE M.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' )) ORDER BY B.BIZ_NM, B.BIZ_ID

SELECT S.SCHDL_SN AS itemId, S.SCHDL_NM AS title, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(S.BGNG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(S.END_DT, '%m-%d %H:%i')) AS subTitle, IFNULL(B.BIZ_NM, S.PLACE_NM) AS meta, IFNULL(C.CD_NM, S.SCHDL_SE_CD) AS badge, 'SCHEDULE' AS actionType, DATE_FORMAT(S.BGNG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS actionDate, S.SCHDL_SN AS actionValue FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN AND R.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID = S.BIZ_ID LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID = 'CAL_SCHDL_SE_CD' AND C.CD = S.SCHDL_SE_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE S.CO_ID = #{coId} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.BGNG_DT < DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND S.END_DT >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY S.BGNG_DT, S.SCHDL_SN LIMIT 30

SELECT W.WORK_ITEM_SN AS itemId, W.WORK_CN AS title, CONCAT('시작 ', DATE_FORMAT(W.WORK_YMD, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' · 예상완료 ', IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(W.EXPT_END_YMD, '%Y-%m-%d'), '-')) AS subTitle, CONCAT('진행률 ', COALESCE(P.PRGRS_RT, W.PRGRS_RT, 0), '% · ', IFNULL(B.BIZ_ABRV_NM, IFNULL(B.BIZ_NM, '공통/기타'))) AS meta, CONCAT('P', IFNULL(W.PRIORITY_NO, 3)) AS badge, 'WORKLOG' AS actionType, '/worklog/dailyList.do' AS href FROM daily_work_item W LEFT JOIN daily_work_progress P ON P.WORK_ITEM_SN = W.WORK_ITEM_SN AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' AND P.PRGRS_YMD = (SELECT MAX(P2.PRGRS_YMD) FROM daily_work_progress P2 WHERE P2.WORK_ITEM_SN=W.WORK_ITEM_SN AND P2.USE_YN='Y' AND P2.PRGRS_YMD<=CURDATE()) LEFT JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID = W.BIZ_ID WHERE W.CO_ID = #{coId} AND W.USER_ID = #{userId} AND W.USE_YN='Y' AND W.WORK_YMD <= CURDATE() AND (W.DONE_YMD IS NULL OR W.DONE_YMD >= CURDATE()) AND COALESCE(P.PRGRS_STTS_CD, W.PRGRS_STTS_CD, 'WAIT') <> 'DONE' ORDER BY IFNULL(W.PRIORITY_NO,3), W.EXPT_END_YMD, W.WORK_ITEM_SN LIMIT 20

SELECT B.BIZ_ID AS itemId, B.BIZ_NM AS title, CONCAT(IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(B.BIZ_BGNG_YMD,'%Y-%m-%d'),'-'),' ~ ',IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(B.BIZ_END_YMD,'%Y-%m-%d'),'-')) AS subTitle, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_mnpw M WHERE M.BIZ_ID=B.BIZ_ID AND M.USER_ID=#{userId} AND M.USE_YN='Y') THEN '내가 참여 중인 프로젝트' ELSE IFNULL(B.BIZ_ABRV_NM,'') END AS meta, IFNULL(C.CD_NM,B.BIZ_STTS_CD) AS badge, 'BIZ' AS actionType, CONCAT('/biz/bizDetail.do?bizId=',B.BIZ_ID) AS href FROM biz_info B LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID='BIZ_STTS_CD' AND C.CD=B.BIZ_STTS_CD AND C.USE_YN='Y' WHERE B.CO_ID=#{coId}
AND B.BIZ_STTS_CD='PRGRS' ORDER BY B.BIZ_END_YMD, B.BIZ_NM LIMIT 30

SELECT CONCAT(CASE WHEN M.USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND M.USER_ID <> '' THEN CONCAT('USER:',M.USER_ID,':') ELSE 'EXT:' END, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(M.INPUT_MNPW_NM),''),'이름없음')) AS itemId, CONCAT(CASE WHEN M.USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND M.USER_ID <> '' THEN CONCAT('USER:',M.USER_ID,':') ELSE 'EXT:' END, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(M.INPUT_MNPW_NM),''),'이름없음')) AS personKey, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(M.INPUT_MNPW_NM),''), U.USER_NM, '외부인력') AS title, B.BIZ_ID AS projectId, B.BIZ_NM AS subTitle, CONCAT('투입률 ',IFNULL(M.INPUT_RT,0),'% · ',IFNULL(NULLIF(M.ROLE_NM,''),'역할 미지정')) AS meta, CASE WHEN M.USER_ID=#{userId} THEN '본인' ELSE '투입중' END AS badge, 'MNPW' AS actionType, CONCAT('/biz/mnpwList.do?bizId=',B.BIZ_ID) AS href FROM biz_mnpw M JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID=M.BIZ_ID AND B.CO_ID=#{coId} LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID=M.USER_ID AND U.CO_ID=B.CO_ID WHERE M.USE_YN='Y'
AND (M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD<=CURDATE()) AND (M.INPUT_END_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_END_YMD>=CURDATE()) ORDER BY title, personKey, B.BIZ_NM, M.BIZ_MNPW_SN

SELECT S.BIZ_SCHDL_SN AS itemId, S.SCHDL_NM AS title, B.BIZ_NM AS subTitle, CONCAT('종료 ',DATE_FORMAT(S.SCHDL_END_YMD,'%Y-%m-%d'),' · D-',DATEDIFF(S.SCHDL_END_YMD,CURDATE())) AS meta, '30일 내 종료' AS badge, 'PROJECT_SCHEDULE' AS actionType, '/biz/schdlList.do' AS href FROM biz_schdl S JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID=S.BIZ_ID WHERE B.CO_ID=#{coId} AND S.USE_YN='Y'
AND S.SCHDL_END_YMD BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY S.SCHDL_END_YMD, S.BIZ_SCHDL_SN LIMIT 30

SELECT U.USER_ID AS itemId, U.USER_NM AS title, IFNULL(D.DEPT_NM,'소속 없음') AS subTitle, IFNULL(U.JBPS_NM,'직급 미지정') AS meta, '재직' AS badge, 'USER' AS actionType, '/attend/orgStatus.do' AS href FROM scope_user S JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID=S.USER_ID LEFT JOIN dept_info D ON D.DEPT_ID=U.DEPT_ID ORDER BY D.SORT_SEQ,U.USER_NM LIMIT 30

SELECT U.USER_ID AS itemId,U.USER_NM AS title,IFNULL(D.DEPT_NM,'소속 없음') AS subTitle, CONCAT('출근 ',DATE_FORMAT(H.GTWK_DT,'%H:%i'),CASE WHEN H.LVWK_DT IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' · 퇴근 ',DATE_FORMAT(H.LVWK_DT,'%H:%i')) END) AS meta, '출근' AS badge,'ORG_STATUS' AS actionType,'/attend/orgStatus.do' AS href FROM scope_user S JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID=S.USER_ID JOIN work_hstry H ON H.USER_ID=U.USER_ID AND H.WORK_YMD=CURDATE() AND H.GTWK_DT IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN dept_info D ON D.DEPT_ID=U.DEPT_ID ORDER BY H.GTWK_DT,U.USER_NM LIMIT 30

SELECT U.USER_ID AS itemId,U.USER_NM AS title,IFNULL(D.DEPT_NM,'소속 없음') AS subTitle, S.SCHDL_NM AS meta,IFNULL(C.CD_NM,S.SCHDL_SE_CD) AS badge,'ORG_STATUS' AS actionType, '/attend/orgStatus.do' AS href FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN=S.SCHDL_SN JOIN scope_user SU ON SU.USER_ID=R.USER_ID JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID=SU.USER_ID LEFT JOIN dept_info D ON D.DEPT_ID=U.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID='CAL_SCHDL_SE_CD' AND C.CD=S.SCHDL_SE_CD AND C.USE_YN='Y' WHERE S.USE_YN='Y' AND S.SCHDL_SE_CD IN('VAC','BIZTRIP','OUTSIDE','HOME','CLIENT') AND NOW() BETWEEN S.BGNG_DT AND S.END_DT ORDER BY U.USER_NM LIMIT 30

SELECT U.USER_ID AS itemId,U.USER_NM AS title,IFNULL(D.DEPT_NM,'소속 없음') AS subTitle, CONCAT('현재 총 투입률 ',IFNULL(SUM(M.INPUT_RT),0),'%') AS meta, CASE WHEN IFNULL(SUM(M.INPUT_RT),0)>100 THEN '과투입' ELSE '정상' END AS badge,'ORG_STATUS' AS actionType, '/attend/orgStatus.do' AS href FROM scope_user SU JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID=SU.USER_ID LEFT JOIN dept_info D ON D.DEPT_ID=U.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN biz_mnpw M ON M.USER_ID=U.USER_ID AND M.USE_YN='Y' AND (M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD<=CURDATE()) AND (M.INPUT_END_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_END_YMD>=CURDATE()) GROUP BY U.USER_ID,U.USER_NM,D.DEPT_NM,D.SORT_SEQ ORDER BY SUM(M.INPUT_RT) DESC,U.USER_NM LIMIT 30

SELECT U.USER_ID AS itemId,U.USER_NM AS title,IFNULL(D.DEPT_NM,'소속 없음') AS subTitle,IFNULL(U.JBPS_NM,'직급 미지정') AS meta, '재직' AS badge,'USER' AS actionType,CONCAT('/user/empDetail.do?userId=',U.USER_ID) AS href FROM user_info U LEFT JOIN dept_info D ON D.DEPT_ID=U.DEPT_ID WHERE U.CO_ID=#{coId} AND U.USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY D.SORT_SEQ,U.USER_NM LIMIT 30

SELECT B.BIZ_ID AS itemId,B.BIZ_NM AS title,CONCAT('계약 ',FORMAT(IFNULL(B.CTRT_AMT,0),0),'원') AS subTitle, CONCAT('종료 ',IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(B.BIZ_END_YMD,'%Y-%m-%d'),'-')) AS meta,'진행' AS badge,'BIZ' AS actionType, CONCAT('/biz/bizDetail.do?bizId=',B.BIZ_ID) AS href FROM biz_info B WHERE B.CO_ID=#{coId} AND B.BIZ_STTS_CD='PRGRS' ORDER BY B.BIZ_END_YMD,B.BIZ_NM LIMIT 30

SELECT C.BIZ_CST_SN AS itemId,IFNULL(C.CST_NM,'비용') AS title,B.BIZ_NM AS subTitle, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(C.OCRN_YMD,'%Y-%m-%d'),' · ',FORMAT(IFNULL(C.OCRN_CST,0),0),'원') AS meta, IFNULL(U.USER_NM,'작성자 미상') AS badge,'ACCOUNT' AS actionType,'/biz/accountList.do' AS href FROM biz_cst C JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID=C.BIZ_ID LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID=C.RGTR_ID WHERE B.CO_ID=#{coId} AND C.USE_YN='Y' AND C.OCRN_YMD BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01') AND LAST_DAY(CURDATE()) ORDER BY C.OCRN_YMD DESC,C.BIZ_CST_SN DESC LIMIT 30
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS itemId,NULL AS title,NULL AS subTitle,NULL AS meta,NULL AS badge,NULL AS actionType,NULL AS href WHERE 1=0
